thread:
emily: Quick proposal  "Recognition Relay" next Wed 4/8 11:45-1:15: small table with 60 mini succulents labeled as 'Plantlet Thank You' + attach ribbon badge for spot-award winners. For remote folks we ship seeds/plant kits. Low-friction, lasts longer than snacks. Thoughts? :seedling:

zack: love it. Logistics Q: shipping cost for remote folks? who owns that expense? :truck:

people-ops: We have a small remote-inclusion budget; shipping under $15/person we'd cover. Need exact counts before we commit. Also payroll note  small goods (non-cash) are tracked; payroll confirms if valuation triggers reporting.

ops-bot: /reminder set "Confirm plant vendor & shipping estimate" for @emily tomorrow 09:00

cory: I can source 60 succulents locally ~ $3.50 each + 60 ribbon badges $28 total. Shipping kits ~$12 each if mailed. Estimate: HQ-only ~ $238 + badges = ~$266. With 10 remote kits adds ~$120 -> ~$386.

hr-payroll: Quick payroll guidance: plantlets <$100 per recipient are de minimis but still need a log of recipient names/emails and values. If we bundle with a voucher or cash equivalent, that requires reporting. We'll want a CSV of recipients.

laura: I can volunteer to staff 12:00-12:45. Happy to do packaging for remote kits on Tue evening.

emily: Nice. Draft plan:
1) emily confirm vendor and shipping by EOD
2) cory to order HQ succulents + ribbons, laura to prep remote kits
3) people-ops to publish 1-line transparency blurb in invite once payroll finalizes wording
4) use /spot-award to log winners during the relay; those recipients will get the plant sticker noting $ value for records

people-ops: Draft invite blurb for now: "Mini plantlets & ribbon badges will be distributed as peer recognition. We track recipients and item value per payroll policy; gifts may be subject to reporting." We'll tighten wording after payroll confirms.

zack: Shipping opt-in link please in invite so we know addresses. Also can we include a short care card for the plant? low effort and cute.

emily: Yes  care card + a tiny QR to digital nomination form. Card template:
```
Plantlet Thank You
Recipient: _______
From: _______
Reason (short): _______
```

cory: I'll bring small kraft boxes for remote kits and tape labels. I can also negotiate a discount with the vendor if we order 75+ plants.

people-ops: Perfect. Action items summarized:
- emily: confirm vendor & shipping estimate (report back here)
- cory: place HQ order & ribbon badges, prep boxes if vendor lead time allows
- laura: staff the table + pack remote kits Tue evening
- hr-payroll: finalize two-line reporting blurb
- ops-bot: reminder to emily set for tomorrow 09:00

emily: Thanks all  I'll update once vendor confirms price and lead time. If vendor stays under $350 we'll submit to #expenses and run it as a micro-activation. :seedling: :sparkles:
